title: pternandra cogniauxii
intro: Pternandra cogniauxii, commonly known as the "Queensland Wild Orange", is a plant species native to Australia. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, improve wound healing, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pternandra cogniauxii include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, as well as antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
